title: Ten days, to scale
summary: The System Audit's header: the approved Specimen sheet (title block retired) whose band is the homepage CTA's ten-tick ruler drawn large, one grid column per working day, so the visitor sees the whole commitment (kickoff, two sessions, read-only access, the readout on Day 10, and what comes after) before being asked anything.

reference.site: Approved Kelwin system: interior/X (the Specimen-sheet header), cta/U (the ten-tick ruler: Kickoff → Readout, 'Phase 01 / 04 · Diagnose'), method/U (the Diagnose bar and its tick scale)
reference.borrowed: Header X's grammar exactly (nav at rest, ■ label + mono breadcrumb, two-voice h1 at 96px, rule, lede, three-row facts ledger, band in a registration frame). The band's subject is the homepage CTA's ruler: the same ten ticks with Kickoff at one end and Readout at the other, and the CTA's meta 'Phase 01 / 04 · Diagnose' as the breadcrumb.
reference.kelwin: The ruler is drawn to the page's own grid: one working day per column, so Day 10 lands on column 10 and the last three columns hold the dotted 'after the readout'. Everything on it is documented scope (D8): two 90-minute sessions bracketed over days 02–09 without inventing dates, read-only access as a bar the length of the window, and the CTA's 'At the readout' note verbatim. The one red element is the Day 10 tick.

motion: entrance: the kit's head choreography (label, h1 line by line, rule, lede, facts at 820ms); the registration marks register at 600–780ms.

orchestrated moment (the page's one header morph): the ruler calibrates — the baseline plots while all 45 ticks drop in left to right, 20ms apart, the numerals fading in behind them (0.9–1.9s); Kickoff lands as Day 01 calibrates. Then the window fills: the read-only bar fills from Day 01 while a 1px playhead runs the ten days (2.0–3.6s), the sessions bracket draws over days 02–09 on the way. As the playhead reaches Day 10 the red tick drops, 'Readout' lands, the playhead fades, the dotted continuation runs on and the after-note fades in (3.6–4.6s). Rests at about 4.6s.
ambient: none. interaction: the facts ledger's 'Three questions' (.ac-go ↓) and the nav's current 'Audit request' both jump to #qualify.
on the live site: the band plays once when the header is 40% visible (it is on load). Reduced motion: the finished drawing at once, no playhead.
story: Opens the page by answering 'what does it ask of me, and what do I get?' before asking anything: the method's Diagnose output becomes the h1, and the homepage CTA's small ruler is drawn at full size so the ten days, the two sessions, the read-only access and the readout are one picture.
copy: [N] h1 'The real constraint, / named in writing.' (picks up the method's Diagnose output)

[R] lede 'Ten working days, fixed scope. We read your narrative, channels and data, and you get a written readout naming the constraint and the order to fix it in — yours whether or not we go further.'
[K D8] You provide · Two 90-minute sessions and read-only access to your CRM and channel stack
(FC) [K AuditSpec 03] You receive · A written readout and a sequenced rebuild plan
[R] band bracket 'Two 90-minute working sessions, scheduled with you'
[K] 'Kickoff' · 'Readout' · 'After the readout · If installation makes sense, we scope it there. If not, the plan is still yours.'
[N] band captions 'Read-only access · your CRM and channel stack', 'Day 01 … 10'
phone: ≤1023: the kit drops the facts under the lede and hides the flags; the sessions label and the after-note hide too, and the figcaption becomes the visible keyed list under the ruler (01 Kickoff · 02–09 two sessions · 10 Readout · after the readout). The ruler keeps its numerals and bar label (HTML, 11px, they never shrink). ≤767: the kit swaps in the phone drawing (358×200): the ruler stays horizontal with one tick per day (no minor ticks), 'Kickoff' and 'Readout' over the end ticks, the bracket marked '02–09 · two sessions', the read-only bar under it, Day 10 still the one red; its words are SVG at 14px (≥11px at 320).
notes: Header height ≈ 1,000px at 1440 (nav 96 + head + 300-unit band + 112 end). No red button in the header: the red is the Day 10 tick only. No day is drawn for the two sessions because none is confirmed. The h1's second line sits beside the facts and ends before col 9.
